mostWorthwhile.text: Building the hair-cell and membrane assembly was most worthwhile: the planned inset and explanation connect fluid motion, bending hair bundles and changed nerve signals.

leastWorthwhile.text: The attempted connection to the incomplete cochlear chambers was frustrating: the feedback did not explain why assembly had to come first.

surprise.text: I expected the chambers to attach directly to the sound-conducting ears, but they needed the sensory assembly first.

arbitrary.text: The required assembly order felt somewhat arbitrary: the descriptions suggested a physical connection, but did not make its prerequisite clear. The pathway from hair-bundle bending to changed nerve signals was also stated rather than explained in detail.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: tracing vibrations into nerve signals was interesting, although I would hope for more explanation of the conversion and clearer assembly prerequisites.
